name: Valkey
description: Valkey is an open-source high-performance key/value datastore commonly used for caching, sessions, queues and application data. Port 6379 is not exposed to the host by default; applications should normally connect through a shared Docker network.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent Valkey data. The directory must be writable by the configured container UID/GID.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Password required by clients connecting to Valkey. Use a strong unique password.

variables.name: Maximum Memory
variables.description: Maximum amount of memory Valkey may use. Increase this according to the workload and available RAM.

variables.name: Memory Policy
variables.description: Behavior when maxmemory is reached. noeviction rejects writes instead of automatically deleting keys.

variables.name: Append Only
variables.description: Enable or disable append-only persistence: yes or no.
